This '''[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] colony''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the criminal [[Sufar]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the colony exiled him for a series of [[Death/Legends|murders]] he committed.
